print(f"FixedTzOffset attrs: {dir(fto)}")
print(f"_offset: {fto._offset}")
print(f"name: {fto.name}")

# Test int_convert with hex
print(f"\nint_convert('0xFF', None): {parse.int_convert('0xFF', None)}")
print(f"int_convert('0x10', 0): {parse.int_convert('0x10', 0)}")
print(f"int_convert('0b1010', None): {parse.int_convert('0b1010', None)}")

print(f"int_convert('-0xFF', None): {parse.int_convert('-0xFF', None)}")

# Test findall case sensitivity
result = parse.findall("{name}", "Hello World hello")
print(f"\nfindall default (case insensitive): {[r.named['name'] for r in result]}")

result2 = parse.findall("{name}", "Hello World hello", case_sensitive=True)
print(f"findall case_sensitive=True: {[r.named['name'] for r in result2]}")

# Test search
result3 = parse.search("{name}", "prefix hello suffix")
print(f"\nsearch: {result3.named if result3 else None}")
